title: GitHub Repository Configuration
description: Schema v1.0.0 — validates repository configuration files in the config/ directory.

name.description: Repository name. Defaults to the YAML filename stem when omitted.

visibility.description: Repository visibility: public, private, or internal.

is_template.description: Whether the repository is a template repository.

auto_init.description: Initialize the repository with a README on creation.

branch_protection.description: Branch protection settings, or null to disable.

pattern.description: Branch name or pattern to protect.

enforce_admins.description: Enforce branch protection rules for repository administrators.

require_signed_commits.description: Require GPG-signed commits on this branch.

required_status_checks.description: Required status checks before merging, or null to disable.

required_pull_request_reviews.description: Required pull request reviews before merging, or null to disable.

strict.description: Require the branch to be up-to-date before merging.

contexts.description: List of required CI check names.

dismiss_stale_reviews.description: Dismiss stale pull request approvals when new commits are pushed.

require_code_owner_reviews.description: Require review from designated code owners.

required_approving_review_count.description: Minimum number of approvals required before merging.
